mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_runs (run_id, task_id, status, expected_count, completed_count, failed_count, user_id) VALUES (#{runId}, #{taskId}, 'submitted', #{expectedCount}, 0, 0, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task_runs WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId} IS NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE task_runs SET status = 'running' WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'submitted' AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId} IS NULL)
UPDATE task_runs SET completed_count = completed_count + 1, status = 'running' WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId} IS NULL)
UPDATE task_runs SET failed_count = failed_count + 1, status = 'running', error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId} IS NULL)
UPDATE task_runs SET status = 'completed', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId} IS NULL)
UPDATE task_runs SET status = 'error', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId} IS NULL)
UPDATE task_runs SET status = 'partial_failed', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId} IS NULL)
